title: An Algorithm for Distributed Computation of a Spanning Tree in an Extended LAN

claims_extracted.claim: The paper presents a distributed algorithm for bridges to compute a loop-free spanning tree over an arbitrarily connected extended LAN.
claims_extracted.notes: Supports design ancestry; it is not by itself the complete IEEE 802.1D standardization history.

claims_extracted.claim: The design selects a root and computes paths so that only an acyclic subset of the physical topology participates in ordinary forwarding.

notes: Primary design source for spanning-tree bridge genealogy. Exact DEC product and IEEE standards revisions must be sourced separately.
